changes: First Modwerk release for Digitakt I OS 1.53 and 1.54, on Core 2.1. Give each MIDI CC assignment a label of up to five characters. Labels appear on CC VALUE and follow native pattern and project operations.

Compatibility flag only: marked as incompatible with digimono, because both patch the same firmware code (0x40030daa on OS 1.53 and 1.54). The site already refused the pair for overlapping firmware changes; it now names the conflict too. Pinned firmware code is unchanged.
